description:
## Goal Build the Cart & Checkout example in examples/cart/. This example validates use_observable, Observable.GenServer, and projection-prevents-re-render. Two components subscribe to the same Cart.Server with different projections: CartBadge gets only the item count, CartView gets the full cart state. Validates: use_observable, Filament.Observable.GenServer, projections, change-or-bust (a CartBadge subscriber should NOT re-render when a cart item's name changes, only when the count changes). ## Deviation policy Any deviation from this spec requires prior approval. Stop work, run `bw comment "..."` describing the conflict, reopen the ticket, and await guidance. Do not improvise. --- ## 0. Prerequisites Read Track D (flm-hom) implementation before writing any code: - lib/filament/observable.ex — Filament.Observable behaviour callbacks - lib/filament/observable/gen_server.ex — the `use Filament.Observable.GenServer` macro - lib/filament/hooks.ex — use_observable/3 signature and opts Confirm: - `use Filament.Observable.GenServer` injects what into the module? - Does `notify_observers/1` take the new state as argument? - What does handle_subscribe/3 return? {: ok, initial_value, new_state}? - What does `project:` opt in use_observable/3 accept? A 1-arity function? Also follow the project structure pattern from G1: - elixirc_paths(:test) in filament/mix.exs already lists "examples/todo/lib" (from G1). Add "examples/cart/lib" to that list. - Create examples/cart/ as a standalone Mix project (mix.exs depends on filament). --- ## 1. Add examples/cart/lib to elixirc_paths FILE: filament/mix.exs (update the elixirc_paths(:test) from G1) ```elixir defp elixirc_paths(:test) do [ "lib", "test/support", "examples/todo/lib", "examples/cart/lib" # add this line ] end ``` --- ## 2. examples/cart/mix.exs Same structure as examples/todo/mix.exs. App name :cart. Module Cart.MixProject. --- ## 3. Domain — Cart.Item struct FILE: examples/cart/lib/cart/item.ex ```elixir defmodule Cart.Item do @enforce_keys [:id, :name, :price_cents] defstruct [:id, :name, :price_cents, quantity: 1] @type t :: %__MODULE__{ id: String.t(), name: String.t(), price_cents: non_neg_integer(), quantity: pos_integer() } end ``` --- ## 4. Domain — Cart.State struct FILE: examples/cart/lib/cart/state.ex ```elixir defmodule Cart.State do defstruct items: [], total_cents: 0 @type t :: %__MODULE__{ items: [Cart.Item.t()], total_cents: non_neg_integer() } def add_item(%__MODULE__{} = state, %Cart.Item{} = item) do # If item already in cart, increment quantity; otherwise append. case Enum.find_index(state.items, &(&1.id == item.id)) do nil -> items = state.items ++ [item] total = state.total_cents + item.price_cents * item.quantity %{state | items: items, total_cents: total} idx -> existing = Enum.at(state.items, idx) updated = %{existing | quantity: existing.quantity + 1} items = List.replace_at(state.items, idx, updated) %{state | items: items, total_cents: state.total_cents + item.price_cents} end end def remove_item(%__MODULE__{} = state, item_id) when is_binary(item_id) do case Enum.find(state.items, &(&1.id == item_id)) do nil -> state removed -> items = Enum.reject(state.items, &(&1.id == item_id)) total = state.total_cents - removed.price_cents * removed.quantity %{state | items: items, total_cents: max(0, total)} end end def item_count(%__MODULE__{items: items}) do Enum.sum(Enum.map(items, & &1.quantity)) end end ``` --- ## 5. Domain — Cart.Server (Observable GenServer) FILE: examples/cart/lib/cart/server.ex Cart.Server is a named GenServer that implements Filament.Observable. Multiple components subscribe with different projections. Mutations (add_item, remove_item) call notify_observers/1 to push the updated state to all subscribers, who then apply their own projection and do change-or-bust comparison (this last step is handled by Track D's notify_observers). ```elixir defmodule Cart.Server do use Filament.Observable.GenServer # Public API def start_link(opts \\ []) do name = Keyword.get(opts, :name, __MODULE__) GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %Cart.State{}, name: name) end def add_item(server \\ __MODULE__, %Cart.Item{} = item) do GenServer.call(server, {:add_item, item}) end def remove_item(server \\ __MODULE__, item_id) when is_binary(item_id) do GenServer.call(server, {:remove_item, item_id}) end def get_state(server \\ __MODULE__) do GenServer.call(server, :get_state) end # GenServer callbacks @impl GenServer def init(initial_state) do {:ok, initial_state} end # Observable callback — called when a new subscriber joins. # Returns {:ok, initial_projected_value, new_server_state}. # Track D's Observable.GenServer macro handles the subscriber bookkeeping; # we only need to return the initial value for this subscriber. @impl Filament.Observable def handle_subscribe(_request, _subscriber, state) do {:ok, state, state} end @impl GenServer def handle_call({:add_item, item}, _from, state) do new_state = Cart.State.add_item(state, item) # notify_observers/1 is injected by use Filament.Observable.GenServer. # It applies each subscriber's projection, does change-or-bust (!==/2), # and sends {:filament_observable_update, fiber_id, slot_index, new_value} # to each subscriber whose projected value changed. notify_observers(new_state) {:reply, :ok, new_state} end @impl GenServer def handle_call({:remove_item, item_id}, _from, state) do new_state = Cart.State.remove_item(state, item_id) notify_observers(new_state) {:reply, :ok, new_state} end @impl GenServer def handle_call(:get_state, _from, state) do {:reply, state, state} end end ``` NOTE: `use Filament.Observable.GenServer` injects: - handle_call({:filament_subscribe, ...}) — subscriber registration - handle_cast({:filament_unsubscribe, ...}) — subscriber removal - handle_info({:DOWN, ...}) — subscriber process death cleanup - notify_observers/1 — private function for pushing updates Do not add handle_info for :DOWN manually — it is already injected. If `use Filament.Observable.GenServer` and `@impl GenServer` conflict (e.g., duplicate handle_call clauses), check Track D's macro expansion for the correct approach. --- ## 6. UI — CartBadge component (count-only projection) FILE: examples/cart/lib/cart_web/components/cart_badge.ex CartBadge subscribes to Cart.Server with a projection that returns only the item count. It will NOT re-render when item names or prices change — only when the count changes. This is the primary validation of Track D's change-or-bust mechanism. ```elixir defmodule CartWeb.Components.CartBadge do use Filament.Component # server prop: which Cart.Server to subscribe to (pid or registered name). # Defaults to Cart.Server for production; tests pass a pid for isolation. prop :server, :any, default: Cart.Server def render(assigns) do # Projection: extract only the count. CartBadge will only re-render when # the count changes, not when item names or prices change. count_projection = fn state -> Cart.State.item_count(state) end # use_observable/3 signature (from Track D): # use_observable(server, request \\ nil, opts \\ []) # Opts: project: fn(state) -> projected_value end # Returns the current projected value (or :uninitialized on first render). # Check Track D (flm-hom.4) for the exact return shape when not yet subscribed. count = use_observable(assigns.server, nil, project: count_projection) ~F""" <%= if count == 0, do: "", else: "#{count}" %> """ end end ``` --- ## 7. UI — CartView component (full-state subscription) FILE: examples/cart/lib/cart_web/components/cart_view.ex CartView subscribes to the full Cart.State (no projection). It re-renders whenever ANY cart mutation fires. Used in the checkout drawer / cart sidebar. ```elixir defmodule CartWeb.Components.CartView do use Filament.Component prop :server, :any, default: Cart.Server def render(assigns) do # No projection — subscribe to full state. cart = use_observable(assigns.server) ~F"""

Your Cart

<%= if cart == :uninitialized do %>

Loading…

<% else %>
    <%= for item <- cart.items do %>
  • <%= item.name %> × <%= item.quantity %> — <%= div(item.price_cents * item.quantity, 100) %> USD
    • <% end %>

Total: <%= div(cart.total_cents, 100) %> USD

<% end %>
""" end end ``` --- ## 8. UI — CartPage LiveView host FILE: examples/cart/lib/cart_web/live/cart_live.ex A LiveView that renders both CartBadge and CartView, sharing the same Cart.Server. ```elixir defmodule CartWeb.CartLive do use Phoenix.LiveView use Filament.LiveView @impl true def mount(_params, _session, socket) do {:ok, server} = Cart.Server.start_link([]) {:ok, assign(socket, server: server)} end @impl true def render(assigns) do ~H"""
Shopping Demo <%= Filament.mount_component(CartWeb.Components.CartBadge, server: @server) %>
<%= Filament.mount_component(CartWeb.Components.CartView, server: @server) %>
""" end end ``` Check Track B for exact Filament.mount_component API (may be named differently). --- ## 9. Test: verify Cart.Server observable behavior FILE: test/filament/examples/cart_test.exs ```elixir defmodule Filament.Examples.CartTest do use ExUnit.Case, async: true alias Cart.{Item, Server, State} alias CartWeb.Components.{CartBadge, CartView} test "Cart.State add_item and remove_item" do state = %State{} item = %Item{id: "a", name: "Widget", price_cents: 999} state = State.add_item(state, item) assert State.item_count(state) == 1 assert state.total_cents == 999 state = State.add_item(state, item) assert State.item_count(state) == 2 assert state.total_cents == 1998 state = State.remove_item(state, "a") assert State.item_count(state) == 0 assert state.total_cents == 0 end test "Cart.Server starts and returns state" do {:ok, server} = Server.start_link([]) state = Server.get_state(server) assert state == %State{} end test "Cart.Server notifies observable subscribers on mutation" do {:ok, server} = Server.start_link([]) # Subscribe manually (using the Filament.Observable.subscribe/3 API from Track D). sub = %Filament.Observable.Subscriber{ pid: self(), fiber_id: :test_fiber, slot_index: 0, project: fn state -> State.item_count(state) end, last_projected: :unset, ref: make_ref() } {:ok, 0} = Filament.Observable.subscribe(server, nil, sub) # Add an item — should trigger notification. :ok = Server.add_item(server, %Item{id: "b", name: "Gadget", price_cents: 1500}) # Expect an update message with the projected count. assert_receive {:filament_observable_update, :test_fiber, 0, 1}, 500 end test "CartBadge component module exists" do assert Code.ensure_loaded?(CartBadge) end test "CartView component module exists" do assert Code.ensure_loaded?(CartView) end end ``` NOTE: The subscriber struct field names (last_projected, ref, etc.) must match Track D's Filament.Observable.Subscriber struct exactly. Read lib/filament/observable/subscriber.ex before writing this test. Adjust field names if different. --- ## Completion criteria 1. `mix compile` succeeds from `examples/cart/` (standalone). 2. `mix compile` succeeds from `filament/` with updated elixirc_paths. 3. `mix test test/filament/examples/cart_test.exs` passes all 5 tests. 4. No compiler warnings for any cart example module.
title: G2: Cart & Checkout example — use_observable with projections, Cart.Server, CartBadge vs CartView
